author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 12, 2022

On Aug 10, 2022, Indonesia-founded brand go-global vendor Jet Commerce (2017) closed $60M+ Series B co-led by Jinqiu Fund, Yinshan Capital (GLP), Zhejiang Silk Road Fund, with Huiyou and ATM Capital following — for ops infra, talent, MCN, digital/SaaS, brand incubation. Six pillars: strategy consulting, shop ops, IMC (community/KOL/live/creative), localized CS + consumer management, multi-type warehousing (3C/beauty/luxury…), SaaS OMS/WMS. Thesis: SEA ecom penetration boom; become leading emerging-market brand service/management firm.

— END —
